facts.fact: Pachan is a Resin House hunter who once gave ten-year-old Neela his sweet at the long table. Hunters carry hooked poles, nets and iron rings on chains.
facts.why: needed because the guild's capture party needs a named, humane-seeming face to make betrayal personal.

facts.fact: Chathu labels every vial in the tapping-shed cupboard in his fine hand; the antidote is tagged 'Black gall, counter' and is a finger-length clay vial with a thumb-pinched wax stopper.
facts.why: needed because Neela must identify the antidote in the cupboard.

facts.fact: Chathu brings Neela a tin of warm jaggery-sesame sweets at dawn; she refuses to touch it (callback to F080).
facts.why: needed because it reinforces his gift-as-bill habit.

facts.fact: The kennels lie under the oldest roof behind the cook-house and a shuttered well; there are forty-one cages of iron, holding animals including a deer, hare, mongoose and fox.
facts.why: needed because the kennel scene needs a concrete scale of the caged.

facts.fact: Chathu keeps the stolen antidote vial (hunters seized it); Ammu was recalled to the Resin House and rode through the night to arrive in the yard on the day of Neela's binding.
facts.why: needed because ch27 has Ammu return the vial and appear at the yard.
